//: The per-component wrappers. They are plain JavaScript components, and their correctness is proved by rendering them: `node tools/check-vue.mjs` mounts every wrapper with @vue/server-renderer and compares the result with the manifest — the props, the classes, the parts. TypeScript still parses them here and resolves their imports, so a syntax error or a missing module is still an error; what it does not do is infer the props of a plain object literal, which is why the wrappers use `defineComponent` and the declarations live in `vue/components/index.d.ts`.
